# MAKOTO LAB

> Independent software and interface studio based in Taipei. Official project introductions and maintained source links are listed on makotolab.tw.

- [Project directory](https://makotolab.tw/#projects): software, wearable and web projects.

## ㄅㄆMac ㄈ / bopo MAC fo

- [Official project page](https://makotolab.tw/projects/bopo-mac-fo/): Mac-style Bopomofo typing logic on Windows; maintained by MAKOTO LAB, built on McBopomofoWeb and PIME.
- [Repository](https://github.com/lancer1234/bopo-mac-fo): source, license details and issue tracking.
- [Releases](https://github.com/lancer1234/bopo-mac-fo/releases): Windows x64 preview installer, source and checksums.
- [Project facts](https://makotolab.tw/projects/bopo-mac-fo/llms.txt): supported platforms, keyboard behavior, upstream credits and limitations.
